hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following his presidential election loss to Lula da Silva, Brazilian Senator Flávio Bolsonaro allegedly fled the country to the United States amid an active money-laundering investigation. The sudden departure has sparked intense political outrage, with President Lula calling the flight 'shameful' while far-right allies in Brazil and the US continue to amplify claims of electoral fraud.
hotspots.affect: The dramatic flight of a major far-right presidential figure under federal investigation, combined with high-stakes international visa disputes and fraud accusations, creates maximum affective charge across right-wing and mainstream outlets alike.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen officially kicked off her 2027 presidential campaign at the 19th Rassemblement National congress in Orléans, promising to restore the rule of law and curb immigration. The high-profile event sparked counter-protests, media spats over proposed union subsidy cuts, and renewed debate regarding her legal eligibility amid pending court appeals.
hotspots.affect: Le Pen's early campaign kick-off coupled with aggressive anti-union proposals and street demonstrations triggers high affective investment between supporters hailing a national revival and critics warning of far-right overreach.

hotspots.title: PP and Vox Pact to Control Spanish Senate
hotspots.blurb: Spain's main right-wing parties, Partido Popular (PP) and Vox, have sealed electoral pacts across multiple provinces to avoid competing against each other for Senate seats ahead of the November 29 general election. The deal has provoked fierce criticism from left-wing parties for destroying political centrality, while sparking internal friction over Vox-linked figures placed on PP candidate lists.
hotspots.affect: High affective investment centers on strategic electoral math aimed at capturing a three-fifths Senate majority to block the progressive government, driving accusations of moderation betrayal and extreme-right takeover.

hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rallies & Campaign Trail Violence
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance are conducting an intensive campaign blitz across key states, holding high-energy midterm rallies in Iowa, Mississippi, and Kansas. Meanwhile, legal battles over mail-in ballot segregation in Washington and California, alongside aggressive rhetoric against political opponents, dominate right-wing election coverage.
hotspots.affect: Aggressive campaign momentum combined with contentious DOJ legal challenges over noncitizen voting claims generates strong emotional polarization and urgency among base supporters.

hotspots.title: SD-bråket avgör högerns framtid
hotspots.blurb: A fierce ideological dispute has erupted at the top of the Sweden Democrats (SD) between prominent party figures Mattias Karlsson and Richard Jomshof over the definition of Swedish identity. Karlsson publicly condemned ethno-nationalist views prioritizing biological heritage as 'revolting,' while Jomshof argues ethnic Swedes must maintain a clear majority to prevent demographic replacement.
hotspots.affect: The high-stakes ideological clash over the core identity of Sweden's dominant right-wing force creates intense affective friction, threatening internal party cohesion and broader right-wing coalition stability.
